author: user
text: Dependency installation can execute code from the PR. Moving it to another checkout does not contain it. Put sandbox_setup inside the same boundary as the agent.

author: claude
text: Moved it inside. The boundary checks run first, then repository setup and the entire agent turn share one sandbox lifetime. Trusted runner setup continues against the reviewed checkout.

author: user
text: The CLI exiting does not mean its background children have stopped. They could still replace an output while we read it. Make an empty sandbox a precondition for export.

author: claude
text: Step three now requires the supervisor to reap every process under the sandbox user and verify none remain before export, including on cancellation. Export accepts only the named, size-limited files and refuses symlinks. The self-hosted rollout choice is the last open point below.
